title: server secret_key uses thread_rng
description: cli.rs:306-310. generate_secret_key() uses rand::thread_rng().fill_bytes() to generate the server secret_key written to the config file. This is a long-lived server secret that should use OsRng directly. While rand 0.8 thread_rng is CSPRNG, using OsRng for long-lived key material is the standard practice (already followed in did.rs and cli.rs persona key generation).
close_reason: rand 0.8 thread_rng() is CSPRNG (ChaCha12 seeded from OsRng). No real confidentiality/integrity impact -- style preference only.
